note: No official general business tax due date was found; an official short-term-rental form shows a July 31 deadline for that permit only.

items.title: Renew Bakersfield business tax certificate
items.authority: City of Bakersfield Finance Department, Treasury Division
items.description: The business tax certificate is valid until June 30 each year. The tax is due July 1 and must be paid before July 31 to avoid penalties; the city does not rely on courtesy reminders.

items.title: Renew Chula Vista business license
items.authority: City of Chula Vista Finance Department
items.description: Business licenses expire on December 31 each year and the owner is responsible for renewing; the city's recent notices set a January 31 penalty-free grace date.

items.title: Renew Fremont business tax certificate
items.authority: City of Fremont Finance Department, Revenue Division
items.description: Renewal is due by 5:00 p.m. on the last day of the month after the certificate's expiration date; the city sends a notice about 60 days before expiration.
items.deadline: Last day of the month after the expiration date

items.title: Renew Fresno business tax certificate
items.authority: City of Fresno Finance Department, Business Tax Division
items.description: Businesses in Fresno hold a business tax certificate. Most renew every six months and some annually; the tax is due within 30 days after each renewal period ends, with penalties after that.
items.deadline: 30 days after the end of each renewal period

items.title: Renew Irvine business license
items.description: Licenses run for 12 months from the first day of the application month. The city mails a courtesy notice 45 days before expiration and assesses a penalty 60 days after.
items.deadline: Within 60 days after the 12-month term ends

items.title: Renew Long Beach business license
items.authority: City of Long Beach Financial Management, Business License Division
items.description: Every business operating in Long Beach needs a general business license. No renewal application is needed: the city mails an annual bill and payment by the delinquent date printed on it renews the license.
items.deadline: Delinquent date printed on the annual bill

items.title: Obtain and renew Los Angeles Business Tax Registration Certificate
items.description: Businesses operating in the City of Los Angeles register for the business tax and renew annually; tax is based on gross receipts and business class.

items.title: Register for and renew Oakland Business Tax Certificate
items.authority: City of Oakland Finance Department, Business Tax Office
items.description: Anyone conducting business in Oakland registers and pays the annual business tax (rates vary by business class on gross receipts); certificates expire December 31.

items.title: Renew Riverside business tax certificate
items.authority: City of Riverside Finance Department, Business Tax Office
items.description: Annual business taxes are due in advance, on or before the expiration date of the current certificate.
items.deadline: On or before the certificate's expiration date

items.title: Pay Sacramento business operations tax
items.authority: City of Sacramento Department of Finance, Revenue Division
items.description: Businesses operating in the city of Sacramento must hold a business operations tax certificate and renew it annually; apply or renew online.

items.title: Obtain and renew San Diego Business Tax Certificate
items.authority: City of San Diego Office of the City Treasurer
items.description: Every business operating in the City of San Diego, including home-based and self-employed businesses, needs a Business Tax Certificate for each business location; the annual tax depends on headcount.

items.title: Renew San Francisco Business Registration Certificate
items.authority: San Francisco Office of the Treasurer & Tax Collector
items.description: Every business operating in San Francisco must register and renew annually; fee depends on gross receipts.

items.title: File San Francisco gross receipts tax return
items.authority: San Francisco Office of the Treasurer & Tax Collector
items.description: Businesses over the small-business exemption threshold file the annual gross receipts tax return.

items.title: File San Francisco payroll expense tax return
items.authority: San Francisco Office of the Treasurer & Tax Collector
items.description: Payroll expense tax applies to businesses whose San Francisco payroll exceeds the exclusion amount.

items.title: Register for and renew San José Business Tax Certificate
items.authority: City of San José Finance Department, Business Tax Registration
items.description: Businesses operating in San José register within 90 days of starting and renew the business tax annually, due the 15th of the month the business started.
items.deadline: 15th of the month the business started

note: No current official renewal date was found; older city documents point to a March filing period.

items.title: Renew Santa Clara business tax certificate
items.authority: City of Santa Clara Finance Department, Business Tax Unit
items.description: Businesses have 30 days after the renewal date to pay the business license tax; a certificate is treated as revoked if the tax is unpaid 90 days after it becomes due.

items.title: Renew Stockton business license
items.authority: City of Stockton Revenue Services Division
items.description: Business licenses carry an annual registration tax plus a rate that depends on the activity. Renewal payment is due 30 days after the license expires; penalties accrue after that.
